scope: International LT/RH S13 2024 specification; announced EPA 2027 changes kept separate
source_method: Official LT/RH PDF physical pages 1–2 screenshots inspected including annotated manufacturer powertrain renderings; OEM HTML inspected for dual DEF, T14 and regulatory changes.

assets.fact: Inline 6, 12.74 L, DOHC, four valves, 23:1, fixed geometry
1800 bar Common Rail; generic functional sequence
Low displacement water pump, six or nine blade fan
Cartridge oil filter and aluminium sump
Three compressor variants: single iron, twin aluminium, twin aluminium clutched
DEF injection downstream of turbo and inside aftertreatment; no DOC, no active DPF regen
Electronic clutch actuator without drawing from air system
2024 external EGR yes, no cooler; announced 2027 external EGR removed, VVT/VVB, 24 V powertrain architecture and no electronically heated catalyst

checks: 10 SVGs fetched and structure and labels inspected
Escaped markup defect in compressor corrected, ECA disc count removed, cooling and fuel labels refined; four revised files exact readback verified.
limitations: Manufacturer renderings are not proof of installed chassis geometry.
Original simplified SVG symbols, not photorealistic or exact mounting views.
No VIN fitment, wiring, physical routing, service procedures or independent technical and rendered visual acceptance.
Do not infer that external EGR is completely absent in EPA 2024: OEM states no EGR in normal operation and no cooler, but external EGR use yes in 2024 comparison.
EPA 2027 is an announced configuration, not present fitment.
